crossRefs.note: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.
Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and brought accusation against the Jews.
They answered Nebuchadnezzar the king, “O king, live for ever!
Then they answered and said before the king, “That Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Judah, doesn’t…
Whoever there is among you of all his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in…
There are certain Jews whom you have appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon: Shadrach, Meshach, and…
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered the king, “Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
These three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.
When he came near to the den to Daniel, he cried with a troubled voice. The king spoke and said to Daniel, “Daniel…
He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear Yahweh, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”

people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: Now it came to pass, when they spoke daily to him, and he didn’t listen to them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai’s reason would stand; for he had told them that he was a Jew.
translations.bsb: Day after day they warned him, but he would not comply. So they reported it to Haman to see whether Mordecai’s behavior would be tolerated, since he had told them he was a Jew.
translations.kjv: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai's matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.
translations.asv: Now it came to pass, when they spake daily unto him, and he hearkened not unto them, that they told Haman, to see whether Mordecai's matters would stand: for he had told them that he was a Jew.
